rationale: Repair the published USER_ANSWER evidence-source seam so runtime lookup is driven by the existing coverage registry and immutable authoritative-publication/certified-evidence artifacts rather than insurer/product/topic-specific Python branches and runtime builder reconstruction. The generic publication gate, publication-backed resolver, materializer, reasoning, decision, explanation, and orchestration algorithms remain unchanged. No new registry or insurance semantic capability is introduced.
supersession_impact: The coverage registry remains the single insurer/product/concept evidence inventory and is reused by adding frozen artifact references to existing concept evidence references. The Star-specific runtime source adapter is retired after migration fixtures are persisted. Historical Star publication and certification builders remain available for tests/history but no longer participate in ordinary answer lookup.
authority_impact: No authority is expanded. Authoritative publication remains the admission authority; the registry only points to already-published immutable artifacts. Certified concepts without authoritative-publication artifact references, including Star waiting_period/PED, continue to fail closed for USER_ANSWER use.
